title: Balancer Delete Accounts and Periods
summary:
If administrators a need to remove an unused account, fix incorrectly imported balances, delete an archived period, or update group account or period configurations during an active period, they can learn how to delete the account or period. Administrators can delete:
- an account from the chart of accounts 
- account data from a period (balances and transactions) 
- a period from Account and status or the period archive (not from the fiscal year)
